title: A heap buffer overflow in the stbl_AddSize function (isomedia/stbl_write.c) of GPAC MP4Box v2.4 allows attackers to cause a Denial of Service (DoS)… (CVE-2025-55640)
description: A heap buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the stbl_AddSize function of GPAC MP4Box version 2.4. This flaw can be triggered by processing a specially crafted MP4 file, leading to a denial of service (DoS) condition.
aiSummary: The vulnerability is a heap buffer overflow in the stbl_AddSize function located in isomedia/stbl_write.c of GPAC MP4Box version 2.4. An attacker can exploit this by supplying a crafted MP4 file, causing the application to crash or become unavailable due to memory corruption. No further technical details or exploitation methods are provided.
aiImpact: Successful exploitation results in a denial of service by crashing the application or causing it to become unresponsive. There is no information about code execution or data corruption beyond the DoS impact.
